reason: An external-service integration plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to Ollama for chat completions, model discovery, usage information, and optional web search and fetch providers.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Ollama，提供聊天模型配置、模型发现、用量查看以及可选的网页搜索和抓取功能。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Ollama for chat model configuration, model discovery, usage details, and optional web search and fetch providers.

capabilities: Connects to Ollama Cloud or self-hosted Ollama endpoints
Stores and uses an Ollama API key through the host credentials API
Provides Ollama-backed web search and web fetch providers
Displays cloud usage and model capability metadata in a settings interface
